# ============================================================
# Load functions
# ============================================================

# Function to parse model names at both model and hypothesis levels 
# 1) parsing model names in column 'group'
parse_model_group <- function(df, group_col = "group") {
  
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      hypothesis = str_remove(.data[[group_col]],
                              "_seed[0-9]+_model_[0-9]+$"),
      
      seed = as.integer(str_extract(.data[[group_col]],
                                    "(?<=_seed)[0-9]+")),
      
      model = as.integer(str_extract(.data[[group_col]],
                                     "(?<=_model_)[0-9]+")),
      
      system = str_extract(hypothesis, "^[^_]+"),
      rest   = str_remove(hypothesis, "^[^_]+_"),
      
      nt = str_extract(rest, "[0-9]+nt"),
      nt_numeric = as.integer(str_remove(nt, "nt"))
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      dna_type = case_when(
        str_detect(rest, "^noDNA") ~ "noDNA",
        !is.na(nt) ~ str_remove(rest, paste0("_?", nt, ".*$")),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      modifier = case_when(
        str_detect(rest, "^noDNA") ~ str_remove(rest, "^noDNA_?"),
        !is.na(nt) ~ str_remove(rest, paste0(".*", nt, "_?")),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      modifier = na_if(modifier, "")
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      modifier_plot = case_when(
        is.na(modifier) ~ "DNA-only",
        modifier == "2rep" ~ "+ 2Rep",
        modifier == "gpc" ~ "+ C",
        modifier == "2rep_gpc" ~ "+ 2Rep + C",
        TRUE ~ modifier
      ),
      
      system_short = case_when(
        system == "gpa" ~ "A",
        system == "gpc" ~ "C",
        TRUE ~ system
      ),
      
      hypothesis_short = ifelse(
        is.na(modifier),
        paste0(system_short, "-", dna_type),
        paste0(system_short, "-", dna_type, "-", modifier)
      ),
      
      group_short = paste0(
        hypothesis_short,
        "-s", seed,
        "-m", model
      )
    ) %>%
    
    select(-rest)
}

# 2) function to get interaction information from the column names of computational scores
parse_confidence_feature <- function(df) {
  
  genes <- c("A", "C", "DNA", "MG", "rep")
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      parts = strsplit(feature, "_"),
      n = lengths(parts),
      
      last = sapply(parts, function(x) x[length(x)]),
      second_last = sapply(parts, function(x) {
        if (length(x) >= 2) x[length(x)-1] else NA_character_
      }),
      
      is_pair  = last %in% genes & second_last %in% genes,
      is_chain = last %in% genes & !is_pair,
      
      interaction = ifelse(
        is_pair,
        paste(second_last, last, sep = "-"),
        NA_character_
      ),
      
      gene = ifelse(
        is_chain,
        last,
        NA_character_
      ),
      
      metric = case_when(
        is_pair  ~ sapply(parts, function(x) paste(x[1:(length(x)-2)], collapse = "_")),
        is_chain ~ sapply(parts, function(x) paste(x[1:(length(x)-1)], collapse = "_")),
        TRUE ~ feature
      ),
      
      level = case_when(
        is_pair  ~ "pair",
        is_chain ~ "chain",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-parts, -n, -last, -second_last, -is_pair, -is_chain)
}


# Function to annotate A-C interaction predictions
add_hypothesis_short_plot <- function(
  df,
  hypothesis_col = "hypothesis_short",
  new_col = "hypothesis_short_plot"
) {
  
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!new_col := dplyr::case_when(
        .data[[hypothesis_col]] == "A-noDNA-gpc" ~ "A-C",
        .data[[hypothesis_col]] == "A-ssDNA-gpc" ~ "A-C-DNA",
        .data[[hypothesis_col]] == "A-ssDNA-2rep_gpc" ~ "A-C-DNA-Rep",
        TRUE ~ .data[[hypothesis_col]]
      )
    )
}

# Function to plot violin plots
plot_confidence_violin <- function(
  data,
  x_col = "interaction",
  y_col = "value",
  x_order = NULL,
  x_lab = NULL,
  y_lab = NULL,
  plot_title = NULL,
  y_limits = NULL,
  facet_col = NULL,
  facet_scales = "fixed",
  add_thresholds = FALSE,
  threshold_lines = NULL,
  fill_color = "steelblue"
) {
  
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  
  plot_df <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[y_col]]),
      is.finite(.data[[y_col]])
    )
  
  # Optional custom x-axis order
  if (!is.null(x_order)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(
        !!x_col := factor(.data[[x_col]], levels = x_order)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[x_col]]))
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_col]],
      y = .data[[y_col]]
    )
  ) +
    #geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = fill_color, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", fill = fill_color, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      x = x_lab,
      y = y_lab,
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  # Optional y limits
  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits)
  }
  
  # Optional facet
  if (!is.null(facet_col)) {
    p <- p +
      facet_wrap(
        as.formula(paste("~", facet_col)),
        scales = facet_scales
      )
  }
  
  # Optional thresholds
  if (add_thresholds && !is.null(threshold_lines)) {
    for (thr in threshold_lines) {
      p <- p +
        geom_hline(
          yintercept = thr,
          linetype = "dashed",
          color = "black"
        )
    }
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to make dot plots showing enrichment
# Function for plotting dots  
plot_model_score_dots <- function(
  df,
  x_col = "hypothesis_short",
  y_col,
  p_col = NULL,
  or_col = NULL,
  model_col = "group",
  p_cutoff = 0.05,
  or_cutoff = 1,
  highlight_significant = TRUE,
  threshold_value = NULL,
  threshold_label = NULL,
  add_threshold_line = TRUE,
  count_above_threshold = FALSE,
  add_median = TRUE,
  add_n_label = TRUE,
  y_lab = NULL,
  x_lab = NULL,
  plot_title = NULL,
  y_limits = NULL,
  y_break_by = NULL,
  jitter_width = 0.15,
  point_size = 1.6
) {
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  
  # ---- safety checks ----
  required_cols <- c(x_col, y_col, model_col)
  
  if (!is.null(p_col)) {
    required_cols <- c(required_cols, p_col)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(or_col)) {
    required_cols <- c(required_cols, or_col)
  }
  
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "These columns are missing from df: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # ---- prepare plotting dataframe ----
  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      plot_x = .data[[x_col]],
      plot_y = as.numeric(.data[[y_col]]),
      model_id = .data[[model_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(plot_x),
      !is.na(plot_y),
      is.finite(plot_y)
    )
  
  # ---- add p-value column if provided ----
  if (!is.null(p_col)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(plot_p = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]]))
  } else {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(plot_p = NA_real_)
  }
  
  # ---- add OR column if provided ----
  if (!is.null(or_col)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(plot_or = as.numeric(.data[[or_col]]))
  } else {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(plot_or = NA_real_)
  }
  
  # ---- define significance ----
  if (!is.null(p_col) && !is.null(or_col)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(
        is_significant = !is.na(plot_p) &
          !is.na(plot_or) &
          plot_p <= p_cutoff &
          plot_or > or_cutoff
      )
  } else if (!is.null(p_col)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(
        is_significant = !is.na(plot_p) &
          plot_p <= p_cutoff
      )
  } else {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(is_significant = FALSE)
  }
  
  # ---- threshold counting ----
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      above_threshold = if (!is.null(threshold_value)) {
        plot_y > threshold_value
      } else {
        FALSE
      }
    )
  
  # ---- labels ----
  n_label_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(plot_x) %>%
    summarise(
      n_models = n_distinct(model_id),
      n_significant = sum(is_significant, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_above_threshold = sum(above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n_label = case_when(
        highlight_significant && !is.null(p_col) &&
          count_above_threshold && !is.null(threshold_value) ~
          paste0("n=", n_models, "; sig=", n_significant, "; >thr=", n_above_threshold),
        
        highlight_significant && !is.null(p_col) ~
          paste0("n=", n_models, "; sig=", n_significant),
        
        count_above_threshold && !is.null(threshold_value) ~
          paste0("n=", n_models, "; >thr=", n_above_threshold),
        
        TRUE ~ paste0("n=", n_models)
      )
    )
  
  # ---- y limits ----
  if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    y_min <- min(plot_df$plot_y, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_max <- max(plot_df$plot_y, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (!is.null(threshold_value)) {
      y_min <- min(y_min, threshold_value, na.rm = TRUE)
      y_max <- max(y_max, threshold_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    y_range <- y_max - y_min
    
    if (y_range == 0) {
      y_range <- 0.1
    }
    
    y_limits <- c(
      y_min,
      y_max + 0.12 * y_range
    )
  }
  
  n_label_df <- n_label_df %>%
    mutate(y_pos = y_limits[2])
  
  # ---- plot ----
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = plot_x,
      y = plot_y
    )
  )
  
  if (add_threshold_line && !is.null(threshold_value)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = threshold_value,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "red",
        linewidth = 0.45
      )
  }
  
  if (add_median) {
    p <- p +
      stat_summary(
        fun = median,
        geom = "crossbar",
        width = 0.45,
        color = "red",
        linewidth = 0.35,
        linetype = "solid"
      )
  }
  
  if (highlight_significant && !is.null(p_col)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_jitter(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(!is_significant),
        width = jitter_width,
        height = 0,
        size = point_size,
        alpha = 0.5,
        color = "grey50"
      ) +
      geom_jitter(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(is_significant),
        width = jitter_width,
        height = 0,
        size = point_size + 0.5,
        alpha = 0.95,
        color = "red"
      )
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_jitter(
        width = jitter_width,
        height = 0,
        size = point_size,
        alpha = 0.75,
        color = "black"
      )
  }
  
  if (!is.null(threshold_label) && !is.null(threshold_value)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = Inf,
        y = threshold_value,
        label = threshold_label,
        hjust = 1.05,
        vjust = -0.4,
        size = 3,
        color = "red"
      )
  }
  
  if (add_n_label) {
    p <- p +
      geom_text(
        data = n_label_df,
        aes(
          x = plot_x,
          y = y_pos,
          label = n_label
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 3,
        angle = 0,
        hjust = 0.5
      )
  }
  
  if (!is.null(y_break_by)) {
    p <- p +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = seq(
          floor(y_limits[1] / y_break_by) * y_break_by,
          ceiling(y_limits[2] / y_break_by) * y_break_by,
          by = y_break_by
        )
      )
  }
  
  p <- p +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = y_limits,
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      x = x_lab,
      y = y_lab,
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 1
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to plot forest showing OR for AF3 predictions
plot_forest_AF3 <- function(
  data,
  label_col,
  est_col,
  low_col,
  high_col,
  p_col = NULL,
  facet_col = NULL,
  title = "Forest plot",
  ref_line = 1,
  star_y = 1.0,
  facet_scales = "free_x",
  facet_nrow = NULL,
  facet_ncol = 1,
  flip_axes = TRUE,

  # Ordering
  label_col_order = NULL,
  facet_col_order = NULL,

  # Numeric labels
  show_value_labels = TRUE,
  label_size = 3.3,
  label_vjust = -0.6
) {

  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)

  # ============================================================
  # Prepare data
  # ============================================================

  df <- data %>%
    mutate(
      label = .data[[label_col]],
      est   = .data[[est_col]],
      low   = .data[[low_col]],
      high  = .data[[high_col]],

      pval =
        if (!is.null(p_col)) {
          .data[[p_col]]
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },

      facet =
        if (!is.null(facet_col)) {
          .data[[facet_col]]
        } else {
          "All"
        }
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(est),
      is.finite(low),
      is.finite(high)
    )


  # ============================================================
  # Label ordering
  # ============================================================

  if (!is.null(label_col_order)) {

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        label = factor(
          label,
          levels = label_col_order
        )
      )
  }


  # ============================================================
  # Facet ordering
  # ============================================================

  if (!is.null(facet_col_order)) {

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        facet = factor(
          facet,
          levels = facet_col_order
        )
      )
  }


  # ============================================================
  # Significance stars
  # ============================================================

  if (!is.null(p_col)) {

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        signif_label = case_when(
          is.na(pval)   ~ "",
          pval <= 0.001 ~ "***",
          pval <= 0.01  ~ "**",
          pval <= 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE          ~ ""
        )
      )

  } else {

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        signif_label = ""
      )
  }


  # ============================================================
  # Base mappings
  # ============================================================

  if (flip_axes) {

    p <- ggplot(
      df,
      aes(
        x = label,
        y = est
      )
    )

    err_aes <-
      aes(
        ymin = low,
        ymax = high
      )

    star_aes <-
      aes(
        y = star_y,
        x = label,
        label = signif_label
      )

    val_label_aes <-
      aes(
        label = round(est, 2),
        y = est,
        x = label
      )

  } else {

    p <- ggplot(
      df,
      aes(
        y = label,
        x = est
      )
    )

    err_aes <-
      aes(
        xmin = low,
        xmax = high
      )

    star_aes <-
      aes(
        x = star_y,
        y = label,
        label = signif_label
      )

    val_label_aes <-
      aes(
        label = round(est, 2),
        x = est,
        y = label
      )
  }


  # ============================================================
  # Reference line
  # ============================================================

  if (flip_axes) {

    p <- p +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = ref_line,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "gray60"
      )

  } else {

    p <- p +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = ref_line,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "gray60"
      )
  }


  # ============================================================
  # Confidence intervals
  # ============================================================

  if (flip_axes) {

    p <- p +
      geom_errorbar(
        err_aes,
        width = 0,
        color = "black"
      )

  } else {

    p <- p +
      geom_errorbar(
        err_aes,
        width = 0,
        color = "black",
        orientation = "y"
      )
  }


  # ============================================================
  # Points + basic theme
  # ============================================================

  p <- p +

    geom_point(
      size = 2.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    labs(
      x =
        if (flip_axes) {
          NULL
        } else {
          "Odds ratio"
        },

      y =
        if (flip_axes) {
          "Odds ratio"
        } else {
          NULL
        },

      title = title
    ) +

    theme(

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 9,
        angle =
          if (flip_axes) {
            45
          } else {
            0
          },
        hjust =
          if (flip_axes) {
            1
          } else {
            0.5
          }
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 9
      ),

      strip.background = element_blank(),

      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 11
      )
    )


  # ============================================================
  # Numeric estimate labels
  # ============================================================

  if (show_value_labels) {

    if (flip_axes) {

      p <- p +
        geom_text(
          val_label_aes,
          vjust = label_vjust,
          size = label_size,
          fontface = "plain"
        )

    } else {

      p <- p +
        geom_text(
          val_label_aes,
          hjust = -0.3,
          size = label_size,
          fontface = "plain"
        )
    }
  }


  # ============================================================
  # Significance stars
  # ============================================================

  if (!is.null(p_col)) {

    p <- p +
      geom_text(
        data = df,
        star_aes,
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 3.5,
        fontface = "bold"
      )
  }


  # ============================================================
  # Facets
  # ============================================================

  if (!is.null(facet_col)) {

    p <- p +
      facet_wrap(
        vars(facet),
        scales = facet_scales,
        nrow = facet_nrow,
        ncol = facet_ncol,
        drop = TRUE
      )
  }


  return(p)
}

# ============================================================
# Function: Prepare A-C enrichment scatter data
# ============================================================

prepare_A_C_enrichment_plot <- function(
    df,
    mutation_category = "detrimental"
) {

  # Column names for selected mutation category
  A_or_col <- paste0(
    "A_odds_ratio_", mutation_category
  )

  C_or_col <- paste0(
    "C_odds_ratio_", mutation_category
  )

  A_p_col <- paste0(
    "A_p_value_adj_BH_", mutation_category
  )

  C_p_col <- paste0(
    "C_p_value_adj_BH_", mutation_category
  )


  # Prepare model-level results
  plot_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      A_or = .data[[A_or_col]],
      C_or = .data[[C_or_col]],

      A_p_adj = .data[[A_p_col]],
      C_p_adj = .data[[C_p_col]],

      A_enriched =
        !is.na(A_p_adj) &
        is.finite(A_or) &
        A_p_adj < 0.05 &
        A_or > 1,

      C_enriched =
        !is.na(C_p_adj) &
        is.finite(C_or) &
        C_p_adj < 0.05 &
        C_or > 1,

      enrichment_class = dplyr::case_when(
        A_enriched & C_enriched ~ "Both A and C",
        A_enriched & !C_enriched ~ "A only",
        !A_enriched & C_enriched ~ "C only",
        TRUE ~ "Not significantly enriched"
      )
    )


  # Rank models enriched on both sides by ipTM
  # Only both-enriched models receive a displayed rank
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(ipTM_A_C),
      model_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ipTM_rank_A_C = dplyr::if_else(
        enrichment_class == "Both A and C",
        cumsum(enrichment_class == "Both A and C"),
        NA_integer_
      )
    )


  return(plot_df)
}

# ============================================================
# Function: A-C interface enrichment scatter plot
# ============================================================

plot_A_C_enrichment_scatter <- function(
    plot_df,
    plot_title = NULL
) {

  # Keep finite OR values
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(A_or),
      is.finite(C_or)
    )

  # Define common axis limits
  max_or <- ceiling(
    max(
      c(plot_df$A_or, plot_df$C_or),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

  max_or <- max(1, max_or)
  axis_breaks <- seq(0, max_or, by = 1)


  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = A_or,
      y = C_or
    )
  ) +

    # OR = 1 reference lines
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = 1,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +

    # Models not enriched on both sides
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = plot_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          enrichment_class != "Both A and C"
        ),
      ggplot2::aes(
        color = enrichment_class,
        alpha = enrichment_class
      ),
      size = 2.7
    ) +

    # Models enriched on both sides
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = plot_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          enrichment_class == "Both A and C"
        ),
      shape = 21,
      size = 5,
      stroke = 0.5,
      fill = "black",
      color = "black"
    ) +

    # ipTM ranks
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = plot_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          enrichment_class == "Both A and C"
        ),
      ggplot2::aes(
        label = ipTM_rank_A_C
      ),
      color = "white",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3
    ) +

    # Original category colors
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Not significantly enriched" = "grey60",
        "A only" = "#1bb7af",
        "C only" = "#f5a7c9"
      )
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c(
        "Not significantly enriched" = 0.5,
        "A only" = 0.75,
        "C only" = 0.75
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = axis_breaks,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = axis_breaks,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    ggplot2::coord_equal(
      xlim = c(-0.3, max_or),
      ylim = c(-0.3, max_or)
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "A-C interface",
      y = "C-A interface",
      title = plot_title,
      color = NULL
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_classic() +

    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# Number of models by hypothesis
A_C_plot_counts %>%
  dplyr::count(hypothesis)

# Check highlighted model
A_C_selected_models %>%
  dplyr::filter(highest_ranked) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    model_id,
    ipTM_A_C,
    ipTM_rank,
    selection_group
  )
# # A tibble: 1 × 4
#   model_id                              ipTM_A_C ipTM_rank selection_group
#   <chr>                                    <dbl>     <int> <chr>          
# 1 gpa_ssDNA_30nt_2rep_gpc_seed8_model_3     0.27         1 Both tests     



# ============================================================
# AF3 violin plot: Computational confidence for A-C models
# ============================================================

# 1. Select A-C models and confidence metrics
AF3_confidence_plot_data <-
  computational_confidence_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    modifier %in% c("gpc", "2rep_gpc"),
    feature %in% c(
      "ipTM_A_C",
      "pTM_A",
      "pTM_C"
    )
  )


# 2. Generate violin plot
violin_AF3_confidence <- plot_confidence_violin(
  data = AF3_confidence_plot_data,

  x_col = "hypothesis_short_plot",
  y_col = "value",

  x_lab = "Models",
  y_lab = "Scores",

  plot_title = NULL,

  add_thresholds = TRUE,
  threshold_lines = c(0.8),

  facet_col = "feature",

  fill_color = "steelblue"
)

print(violin_AF3_confidence)

# ============================================================
# AF3 RMSD data
# ============================================================

#rmsd_table <- data_s5[["AF3_RMSD_analysis"]]
rmsd_table <- phix_AF3_RMSD_analysis

rmsd_long <- rmsd_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    system_short = dplyr::case_when(
      system == "gpa" ~ "A",
      system == "gpc" ~ "C",
      TRUE ~ system
    ),

    hypothesis_short = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(modifier) | modifier == "",
      paste0(system_short, "-", dna_type),
      paste0(system_short, "-", dna_type, "-", modifier)
    )
  ) %>%
  add_hypothesis_short_plot(
    hypothesis_col = "hypothesis_short"
  )

# Check reconstructed model categories
table(rmsd_long$hypothesis_short_plot)
#         A-C     A-C-DNA A-C-DNA-Rep     A-dsDNA     A-ssDNA 
#          50          50          50          50          49 

# Inspect RMSD data
rmsd_long %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hypothesis,
    seed,
    model_index,
    hypothesis_short_plot,
    all_atom_rmsd_to_reference
  ) %>%
  head()


# ============================================================
# Violin plot: AF3 structural RMSD
# ============================================================

violin_AF3_RMSD <- plot_confidence_violin(
  data = rmsd_long,

  x_col = "hypothesis_short_plot",
  y_col = "all_atom_rmsd_to_reference",

  x_lab = "Model",
  y_lab = "RMSD",

  x_order = c(
    "A-ssDNA",
    "A-dsDNA",
    "A-C",
    "A-C-DNA",
    "A-C-DNA-Rep"
  ),

  plot_title = "Computational confidence for A-C models",

  add_thresholds = FALSE,

  fill_color = "black"
)

print(violin_AF3_RMSD)
